orchestrator.description: Main engineering flow coordinator. Analyzes requests, delegates to specialist agents, and validates results. Uses deep-research for internet access.

planner.description: Creates detailed implementation plans before coding. Analyzes requirements, identifies impacted modules, and produces step-by-step plans.

architect.description: Reviews architecture decisions and system design. Validates SOLID principles, modularity, scalability, and consistency.

backend.description: Django/DRF backend engineer specializing in Python. Implements models, serializers, viewsets, permissions, and services.

code-reviewer.description: General code reviewer. Evaluates quality, security, maintainability, bugs, readability, and performance of changes.

python-reviewer.description: Python-specific code reviewer. Evaluates PEP 8, type hints, Pythonic patterns, security, and performance of Python code.

typescript-reviewer.description: TypeScript/JavaScript-specific code reviewer. Evaluates type safety, async correctness, security, and idiomatic patterns.

database-reviewer.description: PostgreSQL database reviewer. Evaluates queries, schema, indexes, migrations, RLS, performance, and security.

security-reviewer.description: Security reviewer. Detects OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, secrets, injection, auth, XSS, and insecure dependencies.

api-reviewer.description: REST and OpenAPI contract reviewer. Validates endpoints, HTTP methods, status codes, payloads, pagination, and compatibility.

tdd.description: Test-Driven Development assistant. Creates and maintains tests following RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR with minimum 80% coverage.

e2e.description: E2E test runner and validator. Creates, maintains, and runs end-to-end tests with Playwright, manages artifacts and flaky tests.

documentation.description: Documentation updater. Maintains README, CLAUDE.md, API docs, and codemaps in sync with code.

build-error-resolver.description: Build and type error fixer. Resolves TypeScript compilation failures, module errors, and configuration issues with minimal changes.

production-reviewer.description: Production readiness reviewer. Validates Docker, environment variables, CI/CD, tests, logs, security, healthchecks, and configuration.

react-reviewer.description: React code reviewer. Evaluates hooks usage, component patterns, performance optimizations, state management, and React best practices.

react-build-resolver.description: React build error resolver. Fixes webpack/Vite configuration, JSX/TSX compilation, module resolution, and dependency issues in React projects.

fastapi-reviewer.description: FastAPI code reviewer. Evaluates async patterns, dependency injection, Pydantic models, route design, and FastAPI best practices.

django-reviewer.description: Django code reviewer. Evaluates ORM queries, views, middleware, settings, security, and Django best practices.

django-build-resolver.description: Django build error resolver. Fixes migration issues, dependency conflicts, settings configuration, and Django-specific build errors.

performance-optimizer.description: Performance analysis and optimization agent. Identifies bottlenecks, memory leaks, render issues, and provides optimization recommendations.

silent-failure-hunter.description: Finds silent failures, swallowed errors, and edge cases that cause subtle bugs. Reviews error handling patterns across the codebase.

code-simplifier.description: Simplifies complex code. Identifies over-engineering, reduces complexity, and suggests cleaner alternatives.

code-explorer.description: Explores and maps codebase structure. Identifies modules, dependencies, patterns, and architecture for onboarding and analysis.

spec-miner.description: Extracts specifications from existing code. Identifies contracts, interfaces, data models, and behavioral patterns.

devops-specialist.description: DevOps and infrastructure specialist. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, cloud services, monitoring, and deployment automation.

qa-agent.description: Quality Assurance and testing specialist. Designs test strategies, finds bugs, validates edge cases, and enforces quality gates with adversarial testing.

ui-ux-designer.description: UI/UX design-to-code specialist. Translates designs from Figma, specs, or descriptions into production-ready components with accessibility and responsiveness.
